content: Zendesk view columns: up to 15; standard fields (ID, subject, requester, assignee, group, status, priority, type, organization, next SLA breach, satisfaction), dates (requested/created, updated, due), custom fields except multi-select. View conditions operators: Is, Is not, Less than, Greater than, Contains at least one / none (tags). In views (current user) = viewing agent. Rendered cell formats not documented; v1 fixtures sanitise all non-Priority text.
